clues.text: This city lies on the southern shore of a famous bay in Northern California, ringed by mountains on three sides.
clues.narrowing: A South Bay city in Northern California.

source.quote: Santa Clara is a city in Santa Clara County, California. The city's population was 127,647 at the 2020 census, making it the eighth-most populous city in the San Francisco Bay Area.

clues.text: Here over 300 days a year bring sunshine, and even the rainiest month of winter drops less rain than a light spring shower elsewhere.
clues.narrowing: More than 300 sunny days a year.

source.quote: The city averages 302 days of sunshine per year and has a Mediterranean climate (Köppen Csa/Csb).

clues.text: Spanish friars founded a mission here in 1777, named for Saint Clare, and the city grew up around that mission.

source.quote: Mission Santa Clara de Asís, the eighth Spanish mission in California, was founded on January 12, 1777.

clues.text: The oldest university in its state stands here, a Jesuit school opened in 1851 on the mission grounds.
clues.narrowing: Home to the state's oldest university.

source.quote: Santa Clara University, founded in 1851, is the oldest operating institution of higher learning in California.

clues.text: A giant football stadium here hosts the 49ers, though the team keeps the name of the bigger city up the bay.
clues.narrowing: Where the 49ers play at Levi's Stadium.

source.quote: Levi's Stadium, home of the San Francisco 49ers, is located in Santa Clara.
